_comment: Priority A of the sheet «Λείπουν 25-11» (chat 7, 25 Nov 2026) with a product feed, from the massive inventory of 26 Nov 2026 (chat 3, lessons L234). One entry per shop and site for sites/_shared/wave-a.js (chat 4): retailer is the name the import will write (older sites only [A-Za-z0-9 .-]); countries never GB; language only when not English. countries come from the feed (Awin programme region, the countries of a Daisycon feed's products, USD/CAD/AUD of a CJ or Rakuten feed), so a shop is shown in at most the countries it sells to, never more; only rows 7, 12 and 47 are from the shop's own delivery page so far. import 'ΟΧΙ ακόμα' = no line yet, 'why' says what is missing.
